actual_Boolean_family: All Boolean tables on n<=3 for block/tree identities; all tables on n<=4 modulo output sign for amplitude selection; all six balanced two-bit seeds, disjoint t-fold products and fresh k-bit activation; one 32-bit symmetric threshold evaluated by binomial sums
justified_symmetry_reduction: Selection fixes output at input zero to +1; output negation preserves all tested quantities. No other reduction.
arithmetic: Direct integer character sums; rational spectra/influences and rational prime-log coefficient vectors for entropy identities. Integer inequalities only for selection and threshold witness. Infinite-parameter remainders checked analytically, not numerically.
pilot: Same fixed domain, halt at 55 seconds with completed-case count and no dimension escalation.
independence: No imported code or execution in another agent directory. Direct character matrix rather than butterfly/Gray implementation. Block restriction reconstruction rather than only coordinate process.
